recipes.name: SMB null-session enumeration
recipes.summary: Hit a range with no credentials to find hosts, their names, OS, and signing status.
recipes.when: The first sweep of an internal range. Null sessions reveal a surprising amount.

recipes.name: SMB shares with credentials
recipes.summary: List the shares every host exposes to a given account, and the access level on each.
recipes.when: You have credentials and want to know what they can read or write.

recipes.name: Password spray over SMB
recipes.summary: Try one password against a list of users across the range, continuing past successes.
recipes.when: You have a user list and one likely password, with scope for an online attack.
recipes.cost: One attempt per user per host.
recipes.warn: Spraying can lock accounts. Agree the lockout threshold in scope and stay under it.

recipes.name: Dump the password policy
recipes.summary: Read the domain password policy so a spray respects the lockout threshold.
recipes.when: Before any spray — know the threshold first.

recipes.name: Pass-the-hash and run a command
recipes.summary: Authenticate with an NT hash and execute a command on every host that accepts it.
recipes.when: You have an admin hash and want to confirm access and run something.
recipes.warn: Command execution on a host is intrusion. Only in scope.

recipes.name: LDAP user enumeration
recipes.summary: Pull all domain users from LDAP, and flag accounts with no Kerberos pre-auth (AS-REP roastable).
recipes.when: You have any domain credentials and want the user list plus easy roasting wins.

recipes.name: WinRM command execution
recipes.summary: Run a command over WinRM, the cleanest remote execution when 5985 is open.
recipes.when: WinRM is reachable and you have working credentials.

recipes.name: MSSQL command via xp_cmdshell
recipes.summary: Execute an OS command through a MSSQL server where xp_cmdshell can be enabled.
recipes.when: You have MSSQL credentials and the account can enable xp_cmdshell.
recipes.warn: Enabling xp_cmdshell changes server configuration. Only in scope.
